Humana announced on Tuesday that investment manager BlackRock would replace private equity company Welsh, Carson, Anderson & Stowe in a $2.8 billion deal to own some of its Centerwell primary care clinics.

Optum's earnings from operations leaped 48% to $3.7 billion during the third quarter, UnitedHealth Group reported.

p: Humana는 화요일, 28억 달러 규모의 CenterWell 일차진료 클리닉 지분 인수 거래에서 사모펀드 운용사인 Welsh, Carson, Anderson & Stowe를 대체할 파트너로 투자운용사 BlackRock을 선정했다고 발표했다.
